_readme: Design branches shown on the GitHub Pages preview (tools/preview.py). Order = order on the chooser page.

designs.label: Option A
designs.name: Editorial menu (current)
designs.blurb: The design the team likes: printed-menu typography, the 28-portrait hero, gold only for booking.

designs.label: Option B
designs.name: House Light · inspired by The Lane
designs.blurb: Quiet and airy: framed portraits on a warm plaster wall, flared capitals, Book always in the sticky strip.

designs.label: Option C
designs.name: Bronze & Sand · inspired by Yukie Natori New York
designs.blurb: Bold and graphic: full-width sand and bronze bands, one modern sans, arrow capsules, leader-line menus.

designs.label: Option D
designs.name: Open Door · inspired by Element Salon
designs.blurb: Bright and friendly: gold-framed white pages, a two-door hero, a black-and-white team wall, "who does what".
